blocks.prompt: 1 A population is given by \(N = 300e^{0.02t}\), where \(t\) is measured in hours. Find the time when the population becomes 600.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh growth ka sawal hai. Model \(N = 300e^{0.02t}\) diya hua hai, aur humein yeh bhi pata hai ke aabadi aakhir mein 600 ho jati hai.
Diya kya hai? Shuru ki aabadi 300, rate constant \(k = 0.02\), aur aakhri aabadi 600.
Find kya karna hai? Waqt \(t\), jo power (exponent) mein baitha hai.
Rule kaunsa? Jab unknown \(e\) ki power mein ho to natural logarithm \(\ln\) use bahar nikalta hai, kyunke \(\ln(e^{x}) = x\).
Plan: 600 rakhenge, 300 se divide kar ke \(e^{0.02t}\) ko akela karenge, phir dono taraf \(\ln\) le kar \(t\) nikalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(N = 300e^{0.02t}\) aur \(N = 600\).
Maloom karna: waqt \(t\) (ghanton mein).
Tareeqa: \(t\) power mein hai, is liye pehle exponential ko akela karenge aur phir \(\ln\) lenge. \(\ln\) aur \(e\) ek doosre ka ulta kaam karte hain, is liye power neeche aa jayegi.

\(N = 600\) rakhein
\[600 = 300e^{0.02t}\]
Kyun: model har waqt sahi hai, to us lamhe bhi sahi hai jab aabadi 600 hai. Is liye \(N\) ki jagah 600 likha.

Exponential ko akela karein
\[\dfrac{600}{300} = e^{0.02t}\]
\[2 = e^{0.02t}\]
Kyun: dono taraf 300 se divide kiya. Ab right side par sirf \(e^{0.02t}\) hai, jis par \(\ln\) seedha kaam karega.
Dhyan dein: 300 ke saath hi \(\ln\) le liya to \(\ln 300 + 0.02t\) banega, sirf \(0.02t\) nahi. Pehle divide, phir \(\ln\).

Dono taraf \(\ln\) lein
\[\ln 2 = 0.02t\]
Kyun: \(\ln(e^{0.02t}) = 0.02t\). Power neeche aa gayi aur ab yeh ek seedhi linear equation hai.

\(t\) nikaalein
\[t = \dfrac{\ln 2}{0.02}\]
\[= \dfrac{0.693147}{0.02}\]
\[\approx 34.66\]
Kyun: dono taraf 0.02 se divide kiya. Calculator se \(\ln 2 = 0.693147\).

Tasdeeq
\[300e^{0.02 \times 34.66} = 300e^{0.6932}\]
\[\approx 300 \times 2.000 = 600 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: jawab wapas rakha to 600 aaya. Ek aur nazar se dekhiye: aabadi 300 se 600 yani double hui, aur double hone ka waqt hamesha \(\frac{\ln 2}{k}\) hota hai, chahe shuru mein kitni bhi aabadi ho. Wohi formula yahan bana.
